idea-plugin.name: cmplx
idea-plugin.description:
Cyclomatic complexity diagnostics and hover for JavaScript, TypeScript and Rust.

Functions scoring at or above the configured threshold are reported as warnings; at or above twice the threshold, as errors. Hovering a function's signature or one of its branchy lines explains the score.

Requires the cmplx binary on your PATH (cargo install --path crates/cmplx), or an explicit path set under Settings | Tools | cmplx.
